opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search and select fastest flight with flexible ticket
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Flights, search a one-way or multi-city itinerary for given origins, destinations, dates and passengers (optionally direct only), sort by Fastest, open the top flight, select it and choose the Flexible ticket before continuing.
steps: Open Booking.com and click the Flights tab
Choose trip type (One way / Multi-city) and set Direct flights only if needed
Enter origin city/airport and select it from suggestions
Enter destination city/airport and select it
For multi-city, add the next leg's origin, destination and date
Pick departure date(s) in the calendar
Set number of adults and click Done
Click Search
Optionally apply a departure-time filter, then click the Fastest tab
Click See flight on the top result and click Select
Choose Flexible ticket and click Next

instances.values: One way, direct only, Bangalore (BLR) → Goa (GOI), 29 Mar 2023, 2 adults, departs 18:00-23:59, Fastest, Flexible ticket
Multi-city: New York → Tokyo on 1 Jun 2023, Tokyo → Delhi (DEL) on 5 Jun 2023, 1 adult, direct only, Fastest, Flexible ticket

opportunities.name: Expedia rental car search with filters and sort
opportunities.description: On Expedia Cars, search rental cars for a pick-up/drop-off location, date range and times, then apply car type/capacity/company filters and sort the results.
steps: Open Expedia and click the Cars tab
Click Pick-up, type the location and select the suggestion
Set drop-off location (same as pick-up)
Open the date picker, pick the pick-up and drop-off dates, click Done
Set pick-up and drop-off times if needed
Click Search
Tick filter checkboxes (capacity, car type, rental company)
Optionally sort by Total Price

instances.values: JFK pick-up/drop-off, Apr 3-6 2023, 9:00 am-6:00 pm, filters 2-5 passengers + Luxury, sort by Total Price
San Francisco, Apr 8-9 2023, default times, filters Avis + Economy

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search with destination, port, dates and guests
opportunities.description: On Carnival, search cruises by Sail To destination, optional departure port and date, then adjust the number of guests on the results page.
steps: Click Sail To and pick a destination
Optionally click Sail From and pick a departure port
Optionally click Dates and pick a month
Click SEARCH CRUISES
On results, open Number of Guests and set the guest count
Remove or adjust filter chips as needed

instances.values: Panama Canal, from San Francisco CA, October 2024
Caribbean, any port and dates, 4 guests

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, open the Airport tab, search an airport, pick it, then set the parking start and end dates and sort the results.
steps: Click the Airport tab
Type the airport name or code in the search box
Select the airport from the list
Set Parking Start Date and End Date in the calendar
Change the sort dropdown (e.g., Shuttle Time)

instances.values: JFK, Apr 18-20 2023, sort by Shuttle Time
Dallas Love Field (DAL), stopped before dates

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup by route
opportunities.description: On new.mta.info, go to Planned Service Changes, search a route and select it, then optionally choose a date to see planned work.
steps: Open Planned Work / Planned Service Changes (via the nav or the menu)
Type the route in Search Routes and select it from the list
Optionally open the date picker, go to the target month and pick a date
